issue.title: test_panel_mixed_bucket_sections_title_and_restore fails under the full parallel lane, passes in isolation
issue.description:
tests/test_models_panel_bucket_navigation.py::test_panel_mixed_bucket_sections_title_and_restore failed on worker gw10 during monitored just check-full xbfsm7s2nb5e (2026-08-16, tree 30c9ba23b plus uncommitted proc_ownership_closeout remediations that do not touch the Models panel). After drilling into bucket:worker with 'l' and restoring with 'h', the highlighted row was launch:default_model instead of bucket:worker.

Isolation: the exact node passed in 0.43s as part of a 5/5 -p no:randomly bundle immediately after the full-lane failure. This is the sase-ct class (ACE TUI red under the full parallel lane, green alone). Retired umbrella sase-ct forbids +1/reopen, so this is a node-specific task.

Scope: find whether restore after _refresh_rows loses the bucket highlight because of row-order/process-global config leakage (launch setting rows shifting) or a race in ModelsPanel highlight restore; isolate the panel from leaked host config if needed; re-measure with just test-contention on this node and tests/reproducible_flake_baseline.txt. Do not treat just test-visual PNG chrome as this defect.

Not caused by proc_ownership_closeout (no Models panel edits).

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-ct — retired umbrella for ACE TUI tests that fail under the full parallel run and pass in isolation. Its close reason forbids +1/reopen and routes this shape to a node-specific task, which is why sase-n5 exists.

RELATED: sase-j7 — in-progress epic fixing the sase-ct flake class at its root (process-global state leaking between tests). This node is the same class; sase-j7.2's leak detector is the natural instrument if host config/launch-setting rows are shifting restore.

RELATED: sase-mv — same check-full run's gw8 config-cache cascade leaked the host athena overlay (llm_provider.default_model, id.machine_name). If that leak can also change Models panel row order, sase-n5 may be a sibling symptom rather than a distinct highlight-restore bug.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by b8559f36f 'fix(ace): stabilize async teardown and interaction waits' (2026-08-21) with a real product fix, not just a test wait: models_panel_providers.py gained _visible_snapshot_keep(), which refuses to restore a snapshot highlight that is not in the current view -- the late-worker-callback race behind the bucket-section title/restore failure -- and the test replaced pilot.pause()/release.wait(timeout=5) with explicit waits on the provider snapshot worker. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
